title: Problem: training use not permitted
description: The one binding MOS-API-112 fixed before the rest of this surface existed, because it is an error classification and chapter 10 owns those: the refusal of MOS-TRAIN-072, when a tenant's training_use_allowed is false, MUST be 403 with type https://spec.medicalos.org/problems/training-use-not-permitted, class authz_error, code TRAINING_USE_NOT_PERMITTED and retryable false. All four values are const here, so the schema cannot drift from the requirement without failing tests/unit/test_permission_contract.py, which reads both. The members are RFC 9457's (MOS-API-035) plus the five extensions MOS-API-037 requires on EVERY problem document. This problem type carries no extension members of its own and the object is closed: MOS-TRAIN-072 states there is no per-study, per-user or per-environment override and no platform-administrator bypass, so there is nothing per-request to report beyond the refusal itself, and a field naming the study would be the per-study dimension the requirement denies.

type.description: MOS-API-036: absolute, under https://spec.medicalos.org/problems/, stable for the life of the major version, never dereferenced at runtime.

title.description: MOS-API-036: short, human-readable, stable per type.

status.description: MOS-TRAIN-072 and MOS-API-112: 403. MOS-API-041 makes authorisation failure a 403 and this is one -- the tenant has not licensed the use, which is not a malformed request and not a clinical answer.

detail.description: MOS-API-036: instance-specific and PHI-free. MOS-TRAIN-074 lets the platform display what the tenant asserted; it does not let it assess it, so a detail explaining WHY a basis is insufficient would be the platform assuming the assertion.

instance.description: The request path. MOS-API-006: no direct identifier in it.

class.description: MOS-API-112, fixed: authz_error. Closed enum under MOS-API-038; the value is pinned rather than enumerated because this type has exactly one.

code.description: MOS-API-112, fixed: TRAINING_USE_NOT_PERMITTED. SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE per MOS-API-037, stable per type.

retryable.description: MOS-API-112, fixed: false. Retrying changes nothing; a human has to record a TrainingDataPolicy (MOS-TRAIN-073).

trace_id.description: MOS-API-004: the same 32-hex value as the MedicalOS-Trace-Id response header.
